model: 4PL ML, N(0,1), D=1, all12 items; no priors
grid_rationale: Endpoints, coarse interior coverage and BOTH preserved Python/R M12 estimates, chosen before profile results
initialization: Same complete preserved R parameter vector at every point; no retries or alternative starts
nuisance: All other47 physical coordinates reoptimized, original box bounds unchanged

optimizer.preconditioner: sqrt diagonal of preserved fine observed-information matrix; fixed before optimization

stationarity: Report raw and per-person box-projected physical nuisance scores; raw max<=1e-5 required (existing preaudit). Optimizer flag alone insufficient. Exclude fixed profile coordinate.
curvature: Descriptive nonuniform three-point second differences only; no chi-square CI, p-value or permanent nonidentifiability claim
independence: Reuse actual archived R solution and existing independently checked common likelihood/score. This protocol does not claim a new independent R optimizer run.
failure_policy: Keep every point, timeout and nonconvergence; no replacement, no threshold changes. A grid diagnosis is not proof of global optimum or of structural identification.
